gse281364.evidence: GSE281364 became public on 2026-03-16, after the registered converted archive. Its human HepG2 and LX-2 MPRA outcomes were not mouse DeepLiver training targets. The model reference and outputs are incompatible with the human source.

gse289173.evidence: The converted archive was last modified on 2025-01-09, before GSE289173 became public on 2025-02-12. Its 48 human donor cell states and signed liver cell-type eQTL and ieQTL outcomes were not mouse topic targets. No native GRCh38 or human gene-effect output exists.

gse296875.evidence: GSE296875 became public on 2025-10-01, after the archive. Its human same-nucleus RNA and ATAC measurements were not mouse topic targets, and the model cannot consume observed expression context.

held_out_behavior.donor: DeepLiver Accessibility has no donor input. Native predictions are identical for every donor at the same 500-bp mouse sequence.
held_out_behavior.human_locus: There is no valid GRCh38 inference path. Liftover cannot transform a human allele into an mm10-trained example or map 82 mouse topic scores to signed human gene effects.
held_out_behavior.mouse_locus: The publication used held training, validation, and test sequence regions, but this does not create a held-human-locus contract. Any future mouse diagnostic must freeze homolog selection and sequence windows without human outcomes.
held_out_behavior.sealed: GSE289173 cannot select mouse topics, orthologs, lifted regions, output combinations, links, directions, calibration, or thresholds.

interpretation: The registered archive predates the named project targets and is target-label-unexposed, but that fact does not make it relevant. DeepLiver Accessibility is a restricted mm10 mouse-topic classifier with approximate Keras-port parity. It has no active v1 task and remains a future cross-species mechanistic diagnostic only.

rules.conversion: The converted Keras artifact inherits the original mouse training exposure but adds conversion uncertainty; approximate correlation cannot establish signed-delta identity.
rules.species: Coordinate liftover does not repair species, training-distribution, topic-semantic, or gene-direction mismatch.
rules.trans_context: DeepLiver accepts only sequence. A mouse liver topic is a fixed output class, not observed human donor RNA context.
rules.variant_direction: A REF-versus-ALT change in an 82-topic score is not a signed eQTL or ieQTL effect and has no native enhancer-gene link.

task_data_gate.gse281364: No active use. At most a future explicitly cross-species mouse-topic diagnostic after terms and conversion parity are resolved.
task_data_gate.gse289173: Not eligible for sealed inference or champion selection because the model has the wrong species, reference, context, and endpoint.
task_data_gate.gse296875: Not eligible for RNA-conditioned ATAC; it neither consumes RNA nor predicts an ATAC profile.
